:::{#def-support}
#### Support of a distribution

The **support** of a discrete distribution
is the set of values it gives positive probability.
The support of a continuous distribution
is the set of values where its density is positive.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-support}
#### Supports of two count distributions

- A fair six-sided die gives each of $1, 2, \ldots, 6$ probability $\tfrac{1}{6} > 0$
  and every other value probability $0$,
  so its support is $\cb{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$.
- A count that can be $0$, $1$, $2$, and so on,
  each with positive probability,
  such as the number of hospital visits in a year,
  has support $\Nat_0 = \cb{0, 1, 2, \ldots}$.

:::
